record.question: The self-preservative action of elixirs is due to the presence of:
record.explanation: Answer C: Alcohol. The alcohol concentration in an elixir contributes to self-preservation by suppressing microbial growth. Source/context note: Not all elixirs contain enough alcohol to be self-preserving; formulation-specific. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK562178/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
